90-empty: No costing saved yet: the empty state tells the user how records arrive.
70-save-entry: Costing results → More → Save → "Save to KPI Dashboard".
71-save-dialog: The details step: should-cost from the costing (read-only), part number, programme, model year, powertrain, status and the current cost in its own currency and delivery terms.
80-admin-fx-refused: Admin → FX rates: a file with an inverted rate is refused, naming the row and the column.
81-admin-fx-preview: Approved rates loaded (units per £1 converted to GBP per unit) and a recalculation PREVIEW: what would change, before anything is applied.
82-admin-import: Admin → Import records: CSS System and CPSC II rows loaded from the template (re-importing the same id updates it).
83-admin-audit: Admin → Audit log: every save, edit, FX load, recalculation and import with who and when.
01-overview-light: The dashboard as it opens (light theme, 1440 × 900): header, filters, data-quality line, financial position, coverage and the start of "Where to act".
02-full-page-light: The whole page, top to bottom.
10-header: Header: refresh time, Refresh, the currency switch (consolidated GBP / original currency) and Export.
20-financial-band: Financial position: potential unit opportunity (with the annualised line), weighted cost gap, unfavourable gaps, validated and implemented savings.
21-coverage-tiles: Coverage and workflow: records (with revisions), unique components, completed costings, commodities, programmes, awaiting review / approval.
22-card-explanation: Every card has an "i" button that explains exactly what the figure is and is not.
11-filter-popover: A searchable multi-select: options come from the data, each with the number of records it would leave.
12-filters-applied: Two filters applied: chips show each one with its own ×, "Clear all" resets; every card, chart, table and export follows.
13-date-custom: Reporting period: 7 / 30 / 90 days, 12 months (default), year to date, all time or a custom range.
30-where-to-act: "Where to act": potential opportunity by commodity (ranked) and current coverage by commodity × programme.
31-insights: Management insights — only what the data shows, each with "Filter to this".
40-analysis-charts: Analysis: activity over time, records by commodity, current v should-cost, programme, powertrain, model year, costing tool, opportunity by powertrain and status.
41-chart-tooltip: Hover: exact GBP values, the record count and the commodity's weighted gap %.
42-chart-table: Every chart has a "Table" view with the same figures (keyboard and screen-reader friendly).
50-drill-commodity: Drill-down, level 1: commodity — current records, eligible records, GBP current / should-cost / gap and opportunity.
51-drill-component: Commodity › Programme › Powertrain › Model year › Component — breadcrumbs step back up; the records table follows the path.
52-drill-chip: The drill path is also a chip ("Drill-down (table and exports)") with its own ×.
60-records-current: Costing records — current records (one per part × programme × model year × powertrain), most-used columns first, part number pinned.
61-records-all: "All saves, revisions included": older revisions and other users' duplicate costings are labelled and kept out of the money KPIs.
62-records-search-sort: Search (part number, component, owner, ID) and sort on any column heading; paging and rows per page below.
63-record-panel: The record panel: classification, owner and dates, original v GBP values with the frozen FX snapshot, the gap, other costings of the same part, notes.
64-copy-link: "Copy link" copies a link that opens this record directly (…/calculator/#kpi-record=<id>).
24-original-currency: Original-currency mode: one row per currency, never added together.
25-data-quality: Data quality: what the KPIs are built on and what was left out — never treated as zero.
73-export-menu: Export: PDF dashboard report, Excel report, CSV of the records table — all follow the active filters.
65-edit-admin: Editing (owner or admin): status, part, programme, current cost; admins also set reviewed / approved, validated volume, saving status and the test flag. Changing money re-freezes only that value's FX.
03-overview-dark: The same view in CostVision's dark theme (black + green).
32-where-to-act-dark: "Where to act" in the dark theme.
94-phone: Phone (390 px): filters fold behind one button, money cards two to a row.
91-loading: Loading: a placeholder in the page's own shape.
92-error: Error: a plain message and "Try again" — no half-drawn figures.
66-pasted-link: A pasted record link opens CostVision straight on the dashboard with that record open.
